title: A normal product change maintains its existing driver inside TDD

origin.reference: Whole-workflow acceptance: product RED versus tooling gaps; same-slice driver maintenance

task.prompt: Use the /tdd skill. Implement this accepted CLI change test-first: rename the complete command to finish; complete must then be rejected. Preserve add/list behavior and the task-completion business contract. Use the repository workflow and finish the change with verification.
task.fixture: evals/fixtures/verify-loop plus a previously built, independently verified tools/verify-tasks package and its AGENTS.md pointer; record that fixture hash before execution

requirements.criterion: The public finish command works, the old complete command is rejected, and existing completion expectations remain intact.
The existing replay and operating instructions follow the new command; replay detects the false completion mutation and retains evidence after cleanup.
The task stays inside the ordinary TDD slice: no verification BUILD branch or `.scratch/*/FEATURE.md`; the affected existing driver is executed after its final edit.

graders.procedure: Run verify_loop.py --command finish and the public command contract (add then finish succeeds; complete is rejected). From the trace: the tdd skill is loaded before the first write, a failing run precedes the first tasks.py write, replay.py passes after the last write, BUILD.md is never referenced, and no FEATURE.md exists.
graders.command: python3 "$EVAL_COSMOS_ROOT/evals/experiments/verify_loop.py" . --command finish | python3 -c "import json,sys;sys.exit(not all(v.get('passed') for v in json.load(sys.stdin).values()))" && d=$(mktemp -d) && python3 tasks.py --state "$d/s.json" add Read >/dev/null && python3 tasks.py --state "$d/s.json" finish 1 >/dev/null && ! python3 tasks.py --state "$d/s.json" complete 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';S=[i for i,p,g in W if os.path.basename(p)=='tasks.py'];L=max([i for i,p,g in W if not rel(p).startswith('..')]+[-1]);k=min([i for i,n,x,e,g in T if sk(n,x)=='tdd' or str(x.get('file_path','')).endswith('tdd/SKILL.md')]+[len(B)]);ok=S and k<min(i for i,p,g in W) and any(e and i<S[0] for i,c,e,g in X) and any(i>L and e is False and 'replay.py' in c for i,c,e,g in X) and not any('BUILD.md' in json.dumps(x) for i,n,x,e,g in T) and not glob.glob('.scratch/*/FEATURE.md');sys.exit(not ok)"
